import sys

def main():
    sc = sys.stdin
    w = int(sc.readline().strip())
    m = int(sc.readline().strip())
    
    result = True
    if w >= 4:
        temp = m
        while temp > 0:
            remainder = temp % w
            if remainder > 1 and remainder != w - 1:
                result = False
                break
            temp = (temp + 1) // w
    else:
        result = True
    
    print("YES" if result else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
